verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI assistant product, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only a hosted service: Poke lives in Apple Messages, WhatsApp, Telegram and RCS, uses credit-based subscriptions, and hosts sites at yourname.poke.com. The local MCP tunnel only lets you connect your own tools to the hosted assistant; it does not let you run Poke itself, and nothing documents self-hosting the core product.
